lane: Mobile app: guide chat and Council say the connection or the AI is unavailable instead of a canned reply
goal: Device test 11/11: with the phone offline, Council answered with a canned on-device reply (labelled fallback). The Owner judged this a bad experience and asked for a clear notice to check the Internet instead. When a backend is configured and the request fails, guide chat and Council show why (no connection, AI busy, sign-in expired), keep the message, and offer Retry; the on-device crisis reply still answers offline. Also hide Retry when the reason is the daily limit or a paused feature.
successCriteria: postJson can throw BackendUnavailableError with reason offline (network failure), busy (timeout, 5xx or unreadable answer) or auth (401) instead of returning null.
generatePersonaReply and generateAiCouncilTurn use it when a backend is configured; with no backend URL the local reply stays (guest/local builds).
If the request fails and the local safety check finds a crisis or boundary signal, the on-device safety reply is still returned.
Guide chat shows an offline or busy notice, keeps the message and offers Retry; daily limit and paused notices show no Retry.
Council shows the same reasons in its room notice and gives the question back.
backendClient tests cover offline, busy and the safety exception; tsc and the app tests pass.
untouchedSurfaces: Tarot keeps card meanings from the 78-card library when the AI is unreachable (real content, already labelled).
Daily insight, zodiac pulse and astrology report keep their current fallback; Oracle moves to AI in the oracle-ai-tools slice.

impact.entryPoint: Send in a guide chat room and in the Council room.
impact.dataWrite: No new writes; the user message stays in the room or the question returns to the box.
impact.backendContract: Same requests; only how the app treats a failed request changes.
impact.adminVisibility: No Admin change; existing persona_message_failed and ai_council_turn_failed events gain a reason.
impact.privacySafety: Crisis and boundary replies still answer on the device without a connection.
impact.observability: Failure events carry reason offline, busy or auth.
impact.rollback: Revert the commit; ships with the next app build.
